project_type: React + TypeScript + Vite social media app (Capacitor mobile-first)
build_system: Vite with bun as package manager. Capacitor for native Android/iOS.
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react. Pre-existing tests have 7 environment errors but 1 passes.
verification_instructions: 1. Run bunx tsc --noEmit (must pass with 0 errors). 2. Run bun run build (must succeed). 3. Pre-existing test errors are acceptable - new code must not break the 1 passing test.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed. Branch feat/ui-redesign already created and checked out.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Bun installed. No Docker needed for verification. Android build available but not required for UI changes.
contribution_requirements: Must pass TypeScript type checking. Must build successfully. Keep all existing functionality working. Keep Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui architecture. Keep Framer Motion for animations. Mobile-first design (Capacitor Android app).
key_patterns: CSS custom properties in src/index.css define the design system tokens (HSL format). Tailwind config extends colors from CSS vars. Components use cn() utility from @/lib/utils for className merging. Pages are in src/pages/. Layout components in src/components/layout/. UI primitives in src/components/ui/ (shadcn pattern). AppShell wraps all authenticated routes with a simulated phone frame (rounded corners + notch) that needs to be removed for real mobile. MobileNav is a fixed bottom bar. Feed has sticky header with translucent backdrop.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - 58 page components. src/components/layout/ - AppShell, MobileNav, SideMenu, AppLoadingScreen. src/components/ui/ - shadcn primitives (button, card, input, etc). src/components/social/ - PostCard, StoriesRail, FeedSkeleton, CommentSheet. src/components/vibe/ - AuraAvatar, VerificationBadge. tailwind.config.ts - Tailwind theme extensions. src/index.css - all CSS custom properties and global styles.
